subject: Discovery follow-up: Demo scheduling + meeting link / timezone fix
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery follow-up: Demo + next steps

Hi Adam / Priya —

Thanks again for taking the time today — great to learn more about FinRetail's goals for personalized recommendations and checkout latency targets. Quick recap:

- Priority: reduce token-level inference cost for reranking and achieve 75ms P95 on critical checkout path
- Current constraints: multi-tenant infra, sensitive PII, requirement for VPC/private deploys for PCI scope
- Next step: 45-min technical demo + performance/ops discussion with your infra and security leads

Attached is a short agenda for the demo (Redwood_DEMO_Agenda.pdf).

I proposed two windows on the calendar: Wed 2026-05-20 10:00–10:45 AM PT or Thu 2026-05-21 2:00–2:45 PM PT — let me know which works or propose alternatives.

Also cc'ing Dev (our SE) so he can cover architecture and benchmarks.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0142

Hi Adam / Priya — Dev here from the Redwood SE team. Thanks for including me. For the demo I'll focus on:

- Architecture for low-latency reranking (KV cache, batching strategies)
- Quantization and performance/accuracy tradeoffs we recommend for e2e cost targets
- Private deployment options (VPC & on-prem) and data flow for PCI-sensitive workloads

If you can fill the short questionnaire Marissa attached, that'll help me prepare a couple of benchmark slides specific to your RPS profile. Otherwise I'll bring a general benchmarking slide set and we can iterate.

See you on Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/999888777
